label: How the portal talks to its mail server

params.name: tries
params.label: How many times one mail is tried before it counts as failed (2 = one automatic retry)

params.name: retry_kinds
params.label: Which failures are tried again (a refused password never is - it would only lock the account)

params.name: site_file
params.label: The portal's own site file (ValueStream CC reads it too)

params.name: site_block
params.label: Its block that sets the sender: from_email and from_name (display name); no from_name = the site file's label

description_nl: default_port / default_security: what a new SMTP setup starts with. timeout_seconds: how long one connection may wait. ssl_port / starttls_port: the port used when none is set, by security. 2026-10-16 owner (mail from CodyFy said 'Justify'): every new site copied smtp.json from the first site found, so all showed that site's name. The sender (display name, address) now comes from the portal's valuestream.site.json block site_block when the file is there - one file per site, set and shown in ValueStream CC (VPS Console -> Mail); smtp.json keeps only the server, login and password. tries / retry_kinds / retry_wait_seconds: a passing timeout (CodyFy invite 2026-10-15, 'The read operation timed out') is tried once more before the mail counts as failed.
weight_basis: Platform access primitive, no business content. The knobs ARE the policy — edit them here, never in Python.
